rationale: Private alpha is local-first and offline-first. Feedback must never leave the machine through a third-party analytics or ticketing service.

privacy_rules.screenshots: Allowed only after the tester confirms no credential, token or real personal data is visible. Store under docs/private-alpha-quality/screenshots/ and reference by filename only.
privacy_rules.tester_identity: Use an alias (for example T-OWNER-1, T-OP-1, T-VIEW-1). Do not store real names, emails or phone numbers in the log.
privacy_rules.test_data: Synthetic or low-risk only. Real sensitive information is prohibited by the validation plan.

tester_alias.note: alias only, never a real identity

build_sha.note: full 40-char SHA the tester actually ran

journey.note: which test script, e.g. Script C - Owner approval flow

user_impact.note: plain language: what the user could not accomplish

evidence.note: commit SHA, test name, or evidence file path

severity_definitions.P0: Security bypass, data corruption, public exposure, cross-workspace access, execution-authority violation, or app unusable. Blocks release unconditionally.
severity_definitions.P1: Login failure, mission flow blocked, approval flow blocked, session dead-end, voice or microphone cannot stop, major mobile failure, recovery failure. Blocks release.
severity_definitions.P2: Confusing workflow, slow route, poor empty state, unclear status, accessibility issue, recoverable error. Does not block, requires owner review.
severity_definitions.P3: Cosmetic, minor copy, low-impact visual inconsistency.

release_gate: No release may proceed while any P0 or P1 item is in a status other than VERIFIED, DEFERRED-with-owner-approval, or NOT_REPRODUCIBLE.
fabrication_rule: Entries may only be created from a real tester session. Automation must never author a feedback entry on behalf of a human, and must never infer a subjective result.
